description: A brain whose full detail would exceed the budget: the summary leaves detail on the pages and names them instead.
me:
Works at [[Schuberg Philis]] as an engineer.
Hobbies: [[Motorcycles]] and [[RC racing]].
Prefers tea over coffee.

pages.name: Schuberg Philis
pages.body: Raymond's employer, in Schiphol-Rijk. He goes to the office on Tuesdays and Thursdays, takes the 08:15 train when the car is in for service, and has lunch in the canteen on the ground floor. The team has a stand-up at 09:30 and a retrospective every other Friday afternoon.

pages.name: Motorcycles
pages.body: Raymond owns a customized Suzuki Bandit with a Yoshimura exhaust, new fork seals in 2025 and a tank repainted in candy red, and a 1979 Honda CB900F being restored as a resto-mod with a modern front end, LED headlight, rebuilt carburettors and a new wiring loom. He rides on dry weekends between April and October.

pages.name: RC racing
pages.body: Races 1:10 scale RC cars on summer weekends at the club track: an Exotek Ultra F1 (Ultra R5) on foam tyres with a 21.5 turn motor, and an Xray X4 '26 touring car on rubber tyres with a 13.5 turn motor and a Hobbywing speed controller. Keeps setup sheets per track and per tyre.
